note: Six altitude tests at Wyle, Brooks City-Base, reached up to 123,000 ft ambient. Occupancy of all six and any DCS outcomes are unavailable. These tests may include the three named human runs listed separately.

Three human tests reported at Wyle in October 2010, November 2011 and September 2012 on two people. The primary balloon pilot did one test and the other pilot did two. The correspondence with the six tests on p. 21 is unresolved. DCS endpoints unavailable.
Five Beale AFB pressure-suit chamber training flights by one pilot. Individual exposure durations and DCS outcomes were unavailable.
Two of the five Beale runs reached 130,000 ft ambient. This row is nested. Actual suit pressure and DCS outcomes were unavailable.
